claims.text: No sampled temperature point-day met both the registered 3 C absolute-departure and |z|=2.5 thresholds.
A sustained spatially coherent departure in the configured sample is weakened; ordinary seasonal or local variation remains plausible.
Forecast skill was not scored because the preserved forecast and realized targets were incompatible.

supersedes.scope: operational report identity only; scientific evidence and claims unchanged

limitations: Four fixed NASA POWER grid proxies are not global or station coverage.
Requested-week realized coverage was four of seven days because of source lag.
The 2021–2025 same-source baseline is not a climate normal.
NASA POWER point series share upstream ancestry and are not independent providers.
